Even though I (19m) have done ~6 months of no masturbation, I struggle all the while with compulsively watching "corn", being unproductive in general, and most of all, feeling like I don't really want to stop these things.

Now because I do nothing all day anyways, I tell myself it's no big deal that I waste all my hours because it's not like I'd be doing anything more productive if I wasn't watching it.

And this leads me to my dilemma, because I know I can stop just like I've stopped masturbation, I just choose not to out of sheer laziness and boredom. So how can I make myself in my heart truly want to be productive?

I know further reducing my libido will help, but beyond cornography that I keep telling myself that pursuing "life" isn't worth it because of how bad it is overall. But I know I could help change it, so why don't I get out there and do that? I guess I want someone to just put me on a path, because all the options are overwhelming (but obviously this isn't possible)
